result: Account 518 (other services) rose from 88 200 Kč in the previous quarter to 120 800 Kč, up 32 600 Kč or 37 %. Cloud and software services add the rest: #39 for 12 318,60 Kč (paid in euros under reverse charge), #40 for 1 581,40 Kč and #41 for 800 Kč. #42 charged the same 800 Kč a second time and #43 refunded it, so the duplicate doesn't change the total.
